title: Vaporesso GTX One Pro Vape Kit
description: vape kits modsThe Vaporesso GTX One Pro is built for dependable performance, everyday reliability and adaptability, with a clear, simple interface and the XTank T tank. Inside the compact mod is a 3000mAh battery with 5–40W adjustable power, supported by fast USB-C 2A charging and Vaporesso’s advanced AXON Chip. A 0.87-inch OLED screen — now larger and easier to read — shows seven key indicators at a glance, including battery level, wattage, resistance, puff count, mode and lock status. Navigation is straightforward: long-press to fire, three clicks for the menu, and five clicks to power on/off. A physical lock button secures your settings when carrying the device. Matched with the kit is the XTank T, a compact 2ml, MTL/RDL tank with a twist-off top-fill cap and adjustable top airflow. Its leak-resistant SSS structure helps contain condensation, while the airflow ring lets you dial from a tight MTL draw to a slightly looser RDL inhale. Two GTX mesh coils are included (0.6ohm pre-installed, 1.2ohm spare) using COREX heating for quick, even wicking and steady flavour. The tank works with the wider GTX coil series, and the box also includes straight MTL and RDL drip tips. The GTX One Pro is finished in your choice of comfortable silicone with unique marbled patterns, or premium PU leather, and is available in Black, Silver, Red, Blue, Pink and Brown. We recommend paring the coils in this kit with the following E-Liquid: 0.6ohm GTX Mesh Coil Pre-Installed pair with - 50/50 (freebase) or Nic Salts E-Liquid 1.2ohm GTX Mesh Coil pair with - 50/50 (freebase), High PG or Nic Salts E-Liquid Browse our vape liquid flavours and enhance your vaping with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
